verdict.rationale: Yubico documents public programmatic interfaces for driving the YubiKey: a .NET SDK, Android and iOS YubiKit libraries, the python-fido2 library and the scriptable ykman CLI. There is also a public YubiEnterprise REST API, but it covers only fleet delivery, inventory and shipments, not operating the key itself. Device-level control goes through local SDKs that need physical presence (a touch), and the docs are human-oriented HTML only. Missing for 10: a network/REST API for device operations, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI probes 404), agent-friendly docs (no llms.txt or markdown), and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
